import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

import numpy as np
from spacr import timeflows_model as tm

root = Path('/mnt/firecuda2/Claude/implementation-20260922/timeflows-426/crop-supervision')
metadata = Path('/mnt/wd4tb/af3/projects/live_cell/timeflows/timeflows_v1.pt.json')
checkpoint = metadata.with_suffix('')

def digest(path):
    value = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1048576), b''):
            value.update(block)
    return value.hexdigest()

def pair_digest(pair):
    value = hashlib.sha256()
    for array in (pair.frame_t, pair.frame_t1, pair.labels_t, pair.labels_t1):
        value.update(str((array.shape, array.dtype.str)).encode())
        value.update(np.ascontiguousarray(array).data)
    return value.hexdigest()

metadata_hash = digest(metadata)
checkpoint_hash = digest(checkpoint)
started = time.monotonic()
groups = []
for movie in json.loads(metadata.read_text())['movies']:
    for sequence in ('01', '02'):
        pairs = tm.ctc_pairs(movie, sequence, max_pairs=3)
        for pair_index, pair in enumerate(pairs):
            before = pair_digest(pair)
            source_counts = dict(zip(*np.unique(pair.labels_t, return_counts=True)))
            target_counts = dict(zip(*np.unique(pair.labels_t1, return_counts=True)))
            trials = []
            for seed in range(16):
                raw_frames, raw_labels = tm.random_window(
                    [pair.frame_t, pair.frame_t1], [pair.labels_t, pair.labels_t1],
                    np.random.default_rng(seed))
                frames, labels = tm._training_window(pair, np.random.default_rng(seed))
                assert all(np.array_equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(raw_frames, frames))
                assert np.array_equal(raw_labels[1], labels[1])
                cropped_source = dict(zip(*np.unique(raw_labels[0], return_counts=True)))
                cropped_target = dict(zip(*np.unique(raw_labels[1], return_counts=True)))
                present = set(cropped_source) - {0}
                false_deaths = {label for label in present if label in target_counts and label not in cropped_target}
                cut_sources = {label for label in present if cropped_source[label] != source_counts[label]}
                cut_targets = {label for label in present if label in cropped_target and label in target_counts
                               and cropped_target[label] != target_counts[label]}
                expected_excluded = false_deaths | cut_sources | cut_targets
                retained = set(np.unique(labels[0])) - {0}
                assert retained == present - expected_excluded
                old_targets, new_targets = tm.time_targets(*raw_labels), tm.time_targets(*labels)
                false_mask = np.isin(raw_labels[0], list(false_deaths))
                assert not old_targets['successor'][false_mask].any()
                assert not new_targets['object_weight'][false_mask].any()
                genuine_absent = retained - set(target_counts)
                genuine_mask = np.isin(labels[0], list(genuine_absent))
                assert (new_targets['object_weight'][genuine_mask] == 1).all()
                assert not new_targets['successor'][genuine_mask].any()
                trials.append({'seed': seed, 'source_objects': len(present),
                    'false_disappearances_before': len(false_deaths),
                    'partial_sources': len(cut_sources), 'partial_targets': len(cut_targets),
                    'censored_objects': len(expected_excluded), 'retained_objects': len(retained),
                    'retained_true_disappearances': len(genuine_absent),
                    'empty_after_censoring': not bool(retained)})
            assert pair_digest(pair) == before
            groups.append({'movie': movie, 'sequence': sequence, 'pair_index': pair_index,
                'pair_array_sha256': before, 'shape': list(pair.labels_t.shape), 'windows': trials})
        print(movie.rsplit('/', 1)[-1], sequence, len(pairs), flush=True)
trials = [trial for group in groups for trial in group['windows']]
summary = {key: sum(trial[key] for trial in trials) for key in trials[0] if key != 'seed'}
summary['windows'] = len(trials)
summary['windows_affected'] = sum(trial['censored_objects'] > 0 for trial in trials)
assert digest(metadata) == metadata_hash and digest(checkpoint) == checkpoint_hash
result = {'metadata': str(metadata), 'metadata_sha256': metadata_hash,
    'checkpoint_sha256': checkpoint_hash, 'source_sha256': digest(Path(tm.__file__)),
    'audit_script_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)), 'audit_script': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'seconds': time.monotonic() - started, 'pairs': len(groups), 'summary': summary,
    'groups': groups, 'checkpoint_unchanged': True, 'source_arrays_unchanged': True,
    'training_started': False,
    'limitations': ['Uses existing full-mask/TRA assignment; does not independently validate those labels.',
        'Repeated crops are dependent observations, not biological replicates.',
        'Censoring removes fast-motion examples outside the fixed tile; it does not solve that receptive-field limitation.',
        'No revised checkpoint or accuracy score.']}
(root / 'real.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'summary': summary, 'seconds': result['seconds']}), flush=True)
